sloka: तेजः क्षमाधृतिर्धैर्यं विनीतत्वं न संशयः ।एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणास्त्वय्येव शोभनाः ।। ६.११६.२९ ।।
transliteration: tejaḥ kṣamādhṛtirdhairyaṁ vinītatvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ।ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāstvayyeva śobhanāḥ ।। 6.116.29 ।।

translations.english: Now with folded palms offering prayers to Sita, Hanuman stood without perturbation, with all humility and again spoke to Sita.
